name: Ura Kagyou
source:
Main character works as a salesman. One business partner company fails to repay 10 million yen. Protagonist does not want to involve police and decides to solve this problem himself - by preying on his targets in all possible ways.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名业务员。某家合作公司拖欠一千万日元，他不愿惊动警方，决定亲手解决问题——以一切可能手段捕食自己的目标。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
